name: Purify a prepared sol by dialysis
subject: chemistry

educational_goal: Study 'Purify a prepared sol by dialysis' using a selected NCERT XII chemistry protocol, its documented quantities and conditions, and conditional observations; review unresolved doses before rendering.
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.

gaps: No vessel safe-working volume or calibrated drop-to-mL conversion has been inferred.
quantity_review.policy: Ranges, approximations, stock amounts, final volumes, capacities, ratios and endpoint additions retain their distinct meanings. Unstated amounts remain absent. Transcription is not scientific approval.

protocol_variants.title: Dialysis of albumin sol
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Prepare a parchment/cellophane cone from a 30 by 30 cm sheet and place albumin sol inside.
procedure_steps.observation: Sol is retained inside the membrane.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
